lineages.Cetacea: Suborder Cetacea within order Artiodactyla in MDD's current placement (whales, dolphins, porpoises) -- not a taxonomic order of its own here, but treated as one of the three marine lineages regardless.
lineages.Pinnipedia: Otariidae, Phocidae and Odobenidae within order Carnivora -- not a taxonomic order of their own.

_meta.note: Marine mammals are not a clade: Cetacea, Sirenia and the pinniped families of Carnivora are three independently aquatic lineages grouped here ecologically, not by descent. See _meta.lineages / _meta.counts and the `lineage` field on every species record.
